The banks will seek to market the debt to institutional investors later this year or in early 2027, the people said. Drax
may also look to refinance outstanding debt, they added.
The financing to pay for the renewable energy acquisition comes as lenders are ready to sell more than $138B of buyout debt in coming months, Bloomberg  said, citing JPMorgan estimates.
